rules.statement: Where a contract cannot be completely performed, the party in default may be ordered to specifically perform his part of the contract as far as possible.
rules.supporting_quote: I do not agree with the argument advanced on appeal that where a contract cannot be completely performed the only remedy is damages. The party in default can be ordered to perform his part of the contract so far as that is possible.

meta.parties: Saparamadu Appuhamy v. Anthony Pulle Et Al
